_comment: Explosion twins (docs/ENVIRONMENT.md). Each 'twin' is a copy in HeartOfMagic.esp of the 'original' explosion
with every field the same except a neutral EditorID, so name-matching mods (Frostwalker) do not read it as an
element. At kDataLoaded the plugin points a magic effect from 'original' to 'twin' only when the effect is by
record a hidden Script effect (no damage) that carries 'original'. The scanner keeps recording 'original'.
Ids are persistentIds ('Plugin|0xLOCALID'). tools/frostwalker-twin-check.js checks every twin here against the
plugin file and Frostwalker's pattern lists; a twin added here needs its record in HeartOfMagic.esp first.

explosions.why: MAG_BlizzardForceExplosion ('blizzard' reads as cold to Frostwalker) is the explosion of Mysticism's hidden screen-shake effect MAG_ScreenShakeEffect (MysticismMagic.esp|0xBDE626), so Fire Storm, Hysteria, Harmony, Mayhem, Paralysis and Bane of the Undead froze water. The twin HoM_ShakeBlastTwin has the same fields from MysticismMagic.esp 2.4.2.0. Real Blizzard (MAG_FrostDamageFFHazardArea, a SpawnHazard effect) keeps the original.
